lineas.desc: Crear la rama del panel de la terminal
Trigger a harmless command to check the hook fires
Check whether the hook recorded the last commands
lineas.cmd: S=$S; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$S/directo/feed/terminal.json'));[print(l['tipo'],l['cmd']) for l in d['lineas'][-4:]]"

lineas.desc: Leer el resultado de la espera de Pages
Buscar tareas pendientes en la documentación
lineas.cmd: git diff --stat HEAD -- tools/directo/terminal_feed.py; grep -rn -i "peachcastle\|THP\|bloqueo\|pendiente" docs/*.md README.md | head -30
